Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke is 0216. Hold Alt, type 0216 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke also has the Unicode codepoint U+00D8, so you can type it with Alt+216 on Windows, search for U+00D8 in macOS's Character Viewer, use Ø in HTML, or \00D8 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity Ø for Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke, but the numeric form Ø is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type latin capital letter o with stroke on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 2 1 6 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke character (Ø) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin capital letter o with stroke on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke" and click the character to insert it.

How to use latin capital letter o with stroke in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00D8"; ()
  • Python: \u00D8 or chr(0xD8)
  • JavaScript: \u00D8 or String.fromCodePoint(0xD8)
  • JSON: "\u00D8"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke is 0216. Hold Alt, type 0 2 1 6 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type Ø without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as Ø, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+216 not work?

Alt+216 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Capital Letter O With Stroke is U+00D8. You can use this value in HTML as Ø, in CSS as \00D8, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type Ø on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00D8, then click it.
